posts.title: Haircuts
posts.author: Peter White
content: Make it worth going to church,
Where I'm at now is this:
I when you'll cut your hair
And I I wait with meaning forming.
My best guess is that's the same.

posts.title: THE MAW THAT KNOWS NOT
posts.author: Peter White
content: They sound sharp, to be avoided,
And leave blood smeared on the tongue,
